title: [review] stack.rs: IPv6 payload length field trusted without validati
description: add_rpl_source_route reads payload_len from ipv6[4..6] and uses it to compute routed_payload_len without verifying it matches ipv6.len() - IPV6_HEADER_LEN. Since the function is pub, callers could pass malformed packets where the header claims a larger payload than actually present, producing output with an incorrect IPv6 length field.
